ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure shows the three-dimensional structure of a silicon n-channel MOS transistor, with two diffusion regions on the left and right in the p substrate; the right side is labeled S (source), and the left side is labeled D (drain). The figure gives the transistor width as 1 µm, the lateral length of the source/drain diffusion regions as approximately 0.2 µm, and the junction depth as approximately 0.2 µm; δ is marked near the edge of the gate and diffusion region, but it corresponds to gate overlap/oxide-layer-related dimensions. Reasoning: According to the problem requirement, find the source-body p-n junction capacitance, considering only the p-n junction area between the source diffusion region and the p-type substrate, including the bottom area of the source region and the four sidewall areas. The source region is approximated as a rectangular diffusion: W = 1 µm, L = 0.2 µm, d = 0.2 µm. Junction area A = LW + 2d(W + L) = 0.2×1 + 2×0.2×(1 + 0.2) = 0.2 + 0.48 = 0.68 µm² = 0.68×10^-12 m². Depletion layer width x_d = 10 nm = 10^-8 m. Use the silicon dielectric constant ε_Si = 11.7ε0 = 11.7×8.9×10^-12 F/m. Thus C_SB = ε_Si A / x_d = (11.7)(8.9×10^-12)(0.68×10^-12)/(10^-8) F ≈ 7.1×10^-15 F, that is, about 7 fF. δ and the SiO2 dielectric constant are not used for the source-body p-n junction capacitance.

method.method_draft: Identify the source-body p-n junction surfaces from the 3D MOS diagram. Model the source as a rectangular diffusion with width W = 1 µm, lateral length L = 0.2 µm, and depth d = 0.2 µm. Compute the junction area as bottom area LW plus all sidewall areas 2d(W + L). Convert µm² to m². Then apply C_SB = (11.7)(8.9×10^-12) A / (10 nm). Ignore δ and the oxide permittivity because they relate to gate/overlap oxide capacitance, not the source-body p-n junction capacitance. The result is approximately 7 fF.

先描述图像：图中是三维 n 沟道 MOS 晶体管结构，底部为 p substrate，左侧是 D 扩散区，右侧是 S 扩散区，中间上方为 G 栅。图中标出晶体管宽度方向为 1 µm，源/漏扩散区在沟道方向的长度为 0.2 µm，扩散结深也标为 0.2 µm；题中还给出耗尽层宽度为 10 nm。
